tagline: Boot Barn is the largest lifestyle retail chain devoted to western and work-related footwear, apparel and accessories in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Same Store Sales KPI is the Hero because it reflects the performance of existing stores and allows assessing how the store base is growing, independent of new store openings.

kpis.name: Same Store Sales
kpis.explanation: Sales from stores that have been open for at least 13 months
kpis.description: Sales from existing (comparable) stores, a key indicator of company performance

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Merchandise sales at retail prices, a key indicator of company performance

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin, a key indicator of company profitability

risks.title: Lease dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on leases for its stores and distribution centers, which may result in risks related to costs and availability of premises. (Item 1A, page 2)

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which may lead to pricing pressures and margin compression. (Item 7, page 39)

risks.title: Litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation-related risks, including potential costs and losses. (Item 3, page 38)

risks.title: Seasonality dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to seasonality-related risks, including fluctuations in sales and results. Q3 represents approximately 32% of annual sales. (Item 7, page 40)

risks.title: Supply chain management risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to supply chain management risks, including disruptions and costs. (Item 7, page 41)

ai_positioning.summary: Boot Barn Holdings, Inc. does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The report primarily focuses on financial information and company operations.
